metrics.name: mc_mob_deaths_total
metrics.help: Custom mobs killed. "killer" distinguishes the player from everything else — a mob killed by the environment is not content being played.

metrics.name: mc_mob_despawns_total
metrics.help: Custom mobs despawned WITHOUT being killed: chunk unload, entity limit, cleanup. A high ratio against spawns signals wasted work.

collector.name: mob
collector.text:
MythicMobs — what spawns, what dies, what despawns.

The difference between dying and despawning is all the information here. A KILLED mob is content being played; a DESPAWNED mob is wasted work — chunk unload, entity limit, cleanup. A server that spawns a hundred mobs and despawns ninety without a kill has a design problem that no other metric would reveal.

The label is the mob TYPE, not its instance: MythicMobs declares a closed list of them in the server files, which makes it exactly the kind of bounded set that makes a good label.
